name: Neutral Milk Hotel
label: Merge
lede: Jeff Mangum made two albums as Neutral Milk Hotel, stopped touring them in 1998 without announcing it, and spent fifteen years out of sight while In the Aeroplane Over the Sea found its audience. By 2013 it had sold more than 393,000 copies without once reaching the Billboard 200.

eras.title: Cassettes before there was a label
eras.text: In Ruston, Louisiana, a few friends traded home-recorded cassettes and invented a record label, Elephant 6, before any of them had put out a record. Mangum recorded alone as Milk, then left town and kept moving.

years.h: In Ruston, a four-track and a stack of cassettes
years.p: Jeff Mangum, son of a Louisiana Tech economics professor, records alone as Milk and trades tapes with [[Robert Schneider|c7c1a16f-65df-47cb-8b03-5b7bcfc7d2ef]], [[Will Cullen Hart|312cf9d4-3d9e-4fbf-9de6-cc358dc3e6e6]] and [[Bill Doss|202b04ad-7c13-4955-b0a2-5ca90371aedf]]. They share a taste for the [[Minutemen|d4ad0149-d8ae-4105-8009-0221fce9ff35]], John Cage and 1960s psychedelia.
years.xp:
Before Milk, Mangum and Hart played together in a punk band called Maggot and an experimental pop project called Cranberry Lifecycle. The four friends dreamed up the Elephant 6 Recording Company as a pretend label for their tapes; it became a real collective a few years later in Athens, Georgia.

Mangum switched to Neutral Milk Hotel after learning another band was already called Milk. Hart suggested the name, and Doss described it as "a non sequitur influenced by the Dada movement."

years.h: Mangum leaves Athens and drifts west with a demo tape
years.p: After a spell in Athens, Georgia, in Synthetic Flying Machine with Doss and Hart, he moves through Denver, Los Angeles and Seattle. On the way he records the Hype City Soundtrack demo as Neutral Milk Hotel.
years.xp: Synthetic Flying Machine turned into [[The Olivia Tremor Control|d62842be-03d8-414b-a8d6-36f4b3b563ed]], with Mangum on drums, vocals and sound effects. Wikipedia also lists him as bassist in Robert Schneider's [[The Apples in Stereo|ea075268-e5ea-40f7-b9c3-68b039218a88]] in this stretch.

years.h: A 7-inch from Seattle keeps the project alive
years.p: Everything Is, Mangum's first proper single as Neutral Milk Hotel, comes out on Cher Doll Records while he's living in Seattle.
years.xp: Mangum has credited the single with saving the project: "The single was a godsend because I was pretty much at the end of my rope."

years.h: [[The Olivia Tremor Control|d62842be-03d8-414b-a8d6-36f4b3b563ed]] put out California Demise
years.p: The debut EP, with Mangum drumming, is one of the first records to carry the Elephant 6 Recording Co. name.

eras.title: Denver, with Schneider at the board
eras.text: The first album is basically Mangum and Robert Schneider in Schneider's Pet Sounds Studio. It sold about 5,000 copies, which was enough to make Mangum want a real band.

years.src: Wikipedia: In the Aeroplane Over the Sea
years.h: Three days of crying over a diary
years.p: Mangum reads The Diary of a Young Girl and dreams of going back in time to save Anne Frank. The book shapes Holland, 1945 and much of the next album.
years.xp: The critic Anwen Crawford wrote that it would be "overly literal" to call In the Aeroplane Over the Sea a record about the Holocaust. Frank's life runs through Holland, 1945 and Ghost, but the album is a stranger thing than a tribute.

years.h: Mangum and Schneider cut the first album in Denver
years.p: Jeff Mangum plays guitar, drums, organs and tapes on a four-track reel-to-reel; [[Robert Schneider|c7c1a16f-65df-47cb-8b03-5b7bcfc7d2ef]] adds fuzz bass, organ and horn arrangements. Trombonist Rick Benjamin guests.
years.xp: Schneider wanted a bigger, more expansive production and came round to Mangum's lo-fi preference. His own account: "at first it was frustrating, but I came to enjoy it."

years.src: Wikipedia: On Avery Island · Wikipedia: Neutral Milk Hotel
years.h: A debut on Merge, and about 5,000 buyers
years.p: Merge puts out On Avery Island in the US; Fire Records follows in the UK on September 30. The Village Voice's Pazz & Jop poll lands it at No. 35.
years.xp:
NME wrote that Mangum turned introspection into folky mantras that "bore into your skull like a well-aimed power drill."

The record closes with a thirteen-minute drone piece built from gamelan and noise ideas. The song Naomi is named for [[Naomi Yang|40b46c2d-5792-4eb4-90d0-e07aa0676479]] of [[Galaxie 500|4de3cfed-b459-42bd-bfbb-7a843fbc73df]]. Mangum and Lisa Janssen made the US cover; Fire commissioned a different one from Jill Carnes.

years.h: A pizza shop in Austin turns up the trumpet player
years.p: [[Julian Koster|5a4afc38-aa20-457e-9ca8-26d62dc1f945]] joins after trading demo tapes with Mangum. [[Jeremy Barnes|e66bf4cf-011b-4279-a83b-7476f981022b]] quits DePaul University in Chicago to drum, and [[Scott Spillane|ed77bb86-b345-436d-89bc-b721571906de]] is the one found at the pizza shop.
years.xp: Barnes got the job after writing Koster a long, introspective letter. The new band moved into Koster's grandmother's house in New York City to rehearse.

eras.title: A summer in Denver, a year on the road
eras.text: One summer at Pet Sounds produced In the Aeroplane Over the Sea. The tour that followed was loud, chaotic and exhausting, and by the end of 1998 Mangum wanted out without ever quite saying so.

years.cap: The four-piece on stage at the 12 Bar Club, London
yt: Full show, 40 Watt Club, Athens, Oct 14, 1997
years.h: The four-piece debuts at Brownies in the East Village
years.p: April 28, New York. The tour money pays for a move to Athens, Georgia, where the rest of Elephant 6 lives.

years.cap: Mangum at the Atomic Music Hall, Athens, c. 1997
years.h: Lance Bangs films Mangum alone in a coffee shop
years.p: Lance Bangs tapes Mangum solo at Jittery Joe's in Athens. The tape stays in a drawer until it comes out in 2001 as Live at Jittery Joe's.

years.src: Wikipedia: In the Aeroplane Over the Sea · Wikipedia: Neutral Milk Hotel
years.h: No distortion pedals, and still that fuzz
years.p: At Pet Sounds Studio, Schneider gets the album's warm fuzz from heavy compression, a Bellari tube preamp and cassette tape pushed into the red. Mangum sits by the control room.
years.xp: Schneider tried electric guitar on some songs and then wiped it, preferring Mangum's acoustic, miked with Neumann U 87s. He wrote the horn parts; Spillane rewrote the trumpet lines from treble to bass clef so he could read them, then piled his own rowdy counter-lines on top.

years.src: Wikipedia: In the Aeroplane Over the Sea · Wikipedia: Neutral Milk Hotel
yt: King of Carrot Flowers Pt 1, live, 1997
years.h: In the Aeroplane Over the Sea starts out small
years.p: Merge presses 5,500 CDs and 1,600 LPs. Early sales look like On Avery Island's all over again.
years.xp:
Chris Bilheimer, who was designing for [[R.E.M.|ea4dfa26-f633-4da6-a52a-f49ea4897b58]] at the time, built the cover from a thrift-shop postcard of bathers; the woman on the dock has a drumhead where her face should be. Brian Dewan drew the inside art, including the flying phonograph.

Reviews split. Pitchfork gave it 8.7 and CMJ ranked it the best album of 1998. Rolling Stone's Ben Ratliff felt "the heavy layer of distortion sometimes masked the absence of decent melodies." It finished No. 15 in the Pazz & Jop poll.
play: In the Aeroplane Over the Sea

years.cap: Neutral Milk Hotel at the Garage, London, August 18, 1998
years.h: Mangum keeps throwing Koster into the drum kit
years.p: Wikipedia says it was routine at the 1998 shows. [[Laura Carter|f8a48346-1ad8-4761-9ea3-9ddc4ade094c]] works as the band's mixing-desk translator for baffled house engineers.
years.xp:
Ben Crum of the band Great Lakes remembered the shows as dangerous: "There often seemed to be a very real chance that someone, probably Julian, would get hurt."

John Fernandes and Will Westbrook joined the tour to cover the horn parts.

years.h: Holland, 1945 gets a single, and then nothing new for a decade
years.p: The song Mangum built out of Anne Frank's story is the last new Neutral Milk Hotel record for more than a decade.

years.cap: Neutral Milk Hotel at the Underworld, London, October 13, 1998
years.src: Wikipedia: Neutral Milk Hotel · Wikipedia: Jeff Mangum
years.h: Mangum plays a solo set at the 40 Watt Club on New Year's Eve
years.p: Nobody announces a breakup. The band just stops.
years.xp: Wikipedia puts the band's last show on October 13, 1998, in London. Band members said later that Mangum kept saying he wanted to quit without explaining why. He told interviewers his basic assumptions about reality started crumbling, that he hoarded rice for Y2K and shut himself away for days.

eras.title: I am a person
eras.text: Mangum disappeared from view while the record he'd left behind found a second life online. The less he said, the more people cared, and the other three kept busy in A Hawk and a Hacksaw, The Music Tapes and The Gerbils.

years.h: In New Zealand, Mangum tells a crowd about his breakdown
years.p: Onstage with [[Chris Knox|77a29700-a307-4568-8063-be553ae062e6]] as World of Wild Beards, he says he hasn't played in three years after a complete nervous breakdown.

years.h: Bulgarian field recordings and a coffee-shop tape, both in 2001
years.p: Mangum releases Orange Twin Field Works: Volume I, Bulgarian folk recordings, on [[Laura Carter|f8a48346-1ad8-4761-9ea3-9ddc4ade094c]]'s Orange Twin label. The 1997 Jittery Joe's solo tape comes out the same year.

years.h: Pitchfork asks about a third album and gets "I don't know"
years.p: That summer Mangum hosts shows on WFMU, playing musique concrete, music therapy tapes and folk field recordings.
years.xp: The full answer, as Wikipedia prints it: "It would be nice, but sometimes I kind of doubt it."

years.big: "I'm not an idea. I am a person."
years.h: A reporter goes looking for Mangum and gets an email back
years.p: Creative Loafing writer Kevin Griffis tracks Mangum down in 2003. The rest of the reply: "who obviously wants to be left alone."
years.xp: Fans filled the silence with hoax blog posts announcing tours that didn't exist. By 2005, In the Aeroplane Over the Sea had sold an estimated 140,000 copies.

years.src: Wikipedia: In the Aeroplane Over the Sea
years.h: Domino reissues Aeroplane, and Pitchfork scores it a 10
years.p: Mark Richardson gives the UK reissue 10.0. In 2003 Pitchfork had already lifted the album from No. 85 to No. 4 on its 1990s list.
years.xp: Richardson called it "a record of images, associations, and threads." Paste later ranked it No. 2 of the 1990s, behind OK Computer.

years.h: Mangum marries the filmmaker Astra Taylor
years.p: Documentary filmmaker and activist [[Astra Taylor|a685aa4a-4025-47f2-adf0-2a41d8ea7fff]] will be onstage with him on guitar and accordion when Neutral Milk Hotel returns.

years.h: Mangum sits in with Olivia Tremor Control at the Bowery Ballroom
years.p: He walks onstage in New York and sings I Have Been Floated with [[The Olivia Tremor Control|d62842be-03d8-414b-a8d6-36f4b3b563ed]].

years.src: Wikipedia: In the Aeroplane Over the Sea
years.h: Aeroplane is 2008's sixth best-selling vinyl LP
years.p: Ten years on it's selling about 25,000 copies a year, per Slate, and counts among the records driving the vinyl revival.

years.h: Mangum turns up on the Elephant 6 Holiday Surprise tour
years.p: He sings Engine at several shows, with [[Julian Koster|5a4afc38-aa20-457e-9ca8-26d62dc1f945]] on singing saw. It's his first public appearance in about three years.

eras.title: Put the cameras away
eras.text: Mangum came back slowly: a benefit, a protest, a festival he curated himself. Then the full band returned for a world tour with one house rule, no photos, and ended it on their own terms.

years.h: A benefit for the man who coaxed him onstage in 2001
years.p: At Le Poisson Rouge in New York, Mangum plays acoustic Neutral Milk Hotel songs to raise money for the New Zealand musician Chris Knox.

years.h: Mangum sells his own vinyl box set from his own site
years.p: Through Walking Wall of Words he self-releases a box that includes the unreleased Ferris Wheel on Fire EP. Part of the money goes to charities including Children of the Blue Sky.

years.h: Mangum plays Occupy Wall Street, unannounced
years.p: He sits down in Zuccotti Park and plays several songs for the protesters. Phone videos are everywhere within a day.

years.h: A vegan benefit for farm animals raises more than $16,500
years.p: Mangum plays the Woodstock Farm Animal Sanctuary in upstate New York.

years.h: Mangum books an ATP weekend and fills it with friends
years.p: At Minehead, England: [[The Apples in Stereo|ea075268-e5ea-40f7-b9c3-68b039218a88]], [[The Olivia Tremor Control|d62842be-03d8-414b-a8d6-36f4b3b563ed]], [[The Music Tapes|11e5be8b-e420-43ff-a8fc-87d8336db556]], [[A Hawk and a Hacksaw|b7cef615-5d43-463f-9032-5d3bc0d96b7f]], plus [[The Fall|d5da1841-9bc8-4813-9f89-11098090148e]], [[Thurston Moore|8ba48525-d922-42ee-9775-97b7b8f9712e]], the Sun Ra Arkestra and [[The Magnetic Fields|3ff72a59-f39d-411d-9f93-2d4a86413013]].

years.h: The full line-up announces its first tour in fifteen years
years.p: Mangum, Koster, Barnes and Spillane are in. Schneider says he'd known for seven years it was coming.
years.xp: Schneider on Mangum's long absence: "The hiatus certainly wasn't purposeful, and I'm not sure [Mangum] even realized he was being a recluse until it was overwhelmingly the case."

years.cap: Neutral Milk Hotel on stage during the reunion tour, 2013
years.h: A Baltimore church hosts the first full show in 15 years
years.p: The venue, 2640, is a former Methodist church turned arts space. Photographers are told, gently but firmly, to put their cameras away.
years.xp: Mangum opened alone before the full band crashed in with The Fool. [[Astra Taylor|a685aa4a-4025-47f2-adf0-2a41d8ea7fff]], Jeremy Thal and Elf Power's [[Laura Carter|f8a48346-1ad8-4761-9ea3-9ddc4ade094c]] filled out the stage. Spin called it ragged and glorious; no new songs were played.

years.src: Wikipedia: In the Aeroplane Over the Sea
years.h: 393,000 copies, and never on the Billboard 200
years.p: That's the total for In the Aeroplane Over the Sea by 2013, from an opening run of 5,500 CDs and 1,600 LPs.

years.h: "It's time to say goodbye for the never ending now"
years.p: On December 10 the band says its spring 2015 run is the last for the foreseeable future, and thanks everyone who came out.

years.cap: Neutral Milk Hotel on the 2014 reunion tour
years.h: The last show is at the Phoenix Theater in Petaluma
years.p: Twenty months after Baltimore, June 11, 2015.

eras.title: Everything in one box
eras.text: With no band left to tour, Merge gathered the whole story in one place, down to the coffee-shop tape. The box got a Grammy nomination the original records never did.

years.h: Merge puts the whole story in one box
years.p: The Collected Works of Neutral Milk Hotel gathers both albums, the EPs and Live at Jittery Joe's. On Avery Island gets new cover art.

years.h: A Grammy nomination for the box
years.p: The Collected Works of Neutral Milk Hotel is up for Best Boxed or Special Limited Edition Package at the 66th Grammy Awards.
